title: Demo unlock CTA on v-harbour fires a real payment_api.check_consent request (payment surface is NOT hidden in demo)
evidence:
client.gleam:3650-3656:
    msg.UserClickedPayCheckout(vid) ->
      case model.checkout_loading, model.unlock_consent_modal_open {
        Some(_), _ | _, Some(_) -> #(model, effect.none())
        None, None -> #(
          Model(..model, checkout_loading: Some(vid)),
          payment_api.check_consent(vacancy_id: vid, on_response: fn(res) {
            msg.ApiReturnedConsentCheck(vid, res)
          })

leaderboard_view.gleam:160: `        view_vacancy_unlock_cta(v, model.checkout_loading, model.pricing),` and :601-602 `case v.is_paid, unscored_count > 0 {` / `False, True ->` (renders the unlock-vacancy-btn with `event.on_click(msg.UserClickedPayCheckout(v.id))`).

demo_store.gleam:283: `"a-ciara" -> Some(analysis_pending("an-ciara", app_id))` — v-harbour is_paid=false with 0 analysed of 1 application, so unscored_count=1 and the CTA renders. demo_update.gleam does not intercept UserClickedPayCheckout (grep finds no match); its fallthrough is `_ -> fallback(model, msg)`.
detail: The PR body claims 'payment surfaces are hidden in demo ... no unlock CTAs appear' — false: the Harbour vacancy leaderboard renders the unlock CTA, and clicking it issues a real network request to the live consent-check endpoint. Violates the 'no Stripe endpoint invocation from demo mode' scope guard. A logged-in landlord's session cookie would even make it succeed.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserClickedPayCheckout (and UserConfirmedUnlockConsent) in demo_update.handle as no-ops, or gate view_vacancy_unlock_cta on !model.demo_mode.

title: Sweep-nudge 'Mark all as Rejected' and select-mode 'Mark selected rejected' issue a real bulk-reject POST from demo mode
evidence:
client.gleam:4841-4859:
    UserClickedMarkAllRejected(vid) ->
      case model.application_detail {
        Success(detail) -> {
          let ids =
            sweep_nudge_banner.open_ids(detail.application, model.leaderboard)
          case ids {
            [] -> #(model, effect.none())
            _ -> #(
              Model(..model, bulk_reject_loading: True),
              application_api.bulk_reject_applications(
                vid,
                ids,
                "sweep_nudge",
                model.csrf_token,
                ApiReturnedBulkReject,
              )

(same for UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected at :4862-4877 with application_api.bulk_reject_applications). No demo_mode branch in either arm, and demo_update.gleam intercepts neither message (fallthrough `_ -> fallback(model, msg)`). Reachability: application_detail.gleam:127-144 renders the banner with no demo guard (`sweep_nudge_banner.view(...)` via `show_sweep`); banner buttons dispatch the messages (sweep_nudge_banner.gleam:144 `event.on_click(msg.UserClickedMarkAllRejected(vacancy_id))`, select_mode_action_bar.gleam:67 `event.on_click(msg.UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected(vacancy_id))`).
detail: Approving a demo applicant (demo-handled) then returning to their detail page shows the sweep-nudge banner (v-maples has non-terminal under_review/submitted entries). Clicking either bulk-reject action sends a real POST to the live bulk-reject endpoint with csrf 'demo-csrf-token'. Server-side CSRF blocks it, but demo mode provably issues a write attempt to a real endpoint — breaking the acceptance pillar.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserClickedMarkAllRejected and UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected in demo_update.handle (mutate the store like demo_status), or add demo_mode branches in the two update_inner arms.

title: Closing a demo vacancy surfaces the 'Extend for €99' button, whose click fires a real payment_api.check_consent / create_extension_checkout call
evidence:
vacancy_detail.gleam:367-372 (view_actions_closed):
    False -> [
      view_extend_button(v.id, is_extending, any_loading),
      view_archive_button_primary(v.id, is_archiving, any_loading),
    ]
and view_extend_button dispatches `event.on_click(msg.UserClickedExtendVacancy(vacancy_id))` (:402). client.gleam:3845-3856:
    msg.UserClickedExtendVacancy(vid) ->
      ...
        None, None -> #(
          Model(..model, extension_checkout_loading: Some(vid)),
          payment_api.check_consent(vacancy_id: vid, on_response: fn(res) {
            msg.ApiReturnedExtensionConsentCheck(vid, res)
          }),
Neither UserClickedExtendVacancy nor UserConfirmedExtensionConsent is intercepted by demo_update.gleam. demo_update handles UserConfirmedCloseVacancy (store mutation), so a demo user can close The Maples and reach the closed-not-archived state where the extend button renders.
detail: Two-click path in demo (close vacancy, then Extend) reaches a live Stripe-related endpoint with the demo CSRF token. Server rejects it, but it is another real endpoint contact from demo mode that the CI grep lint (demo/ modules only) cannot catch.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserClickedExtendVacancy / UserConfirmedExtensionConsent in demo_update.handle as no-ops (or hide view_extend_button when model.demo_mode).

title: Demo seeds a literal csrf_token "demo-csrf-token"; server-side CSRF rejection is the only barrier for the leaked write paths above
evidence:
From the diff (enter_demo in client.gleam):
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,
          demo_store: Some(store),
detail: Harmless in itself (the token can never match a real session, so the leaked bulk-reject/checkout POSTs fail closed server-side), but it means the demo's no-write guarantee rests entirely on server middleware rather than client-side gating. Worth a comment cross-reference or the demo_update interceptions above.
recommended_fix: No code change required once findings 1-3 are intercepted client-side; optionally document that the sentinel token is deliberate fail-closed design.
